# Interview Prep Buddy

> Interview Prep Buddy (https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in) is a free, all-in-one technical interview preparation platform for software engineers. It provides DSA pattern cheatsheets, interactive algorithm visualizers, coding labs, 1400+ interview questions, MCQ quizzes, system design guides, and company-specific interview prep — all in one place.

## What is this site?

Interview Prep Buddy helps developers prepare for technical interviews at Google, Amazon, Meta, Microsoft, Apple, and other top tech companies. Built by Prathamesh Pawar, a full-stack software developer. No login or payment required for any core feature.

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/) — Overview and navigation to all features
- [Interview Questions Hub](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/interview-questions) — 1400+ curated interview questions across 15+ topics
- [DSA Patterns Cheatsheet](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/dsa/patterns) — 16 core algorithm patterns with code blueprints
- [DSA Problem List](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/dsa/problems) — Problems organized by topic, difficulty, and company
- [Algorithm Visualizer](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/visualizer) — Step-by-step interactive algorithm animations
- [Interactive Labs](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/labs) — Browser-based coding environments for JS, React, DSA
- [MCQ Quiz Hub](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/mcq) — Practice quizzes across 15+ technology categories
- [System Design (HLD)](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/system-design) — High-Level Design interview preparation
- [Low-Level Design (LLD)](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/lld) — Machine coding and object-oriented design interview prep
- [About](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/about) — Platform overview and tech stack

## Algorithm Visualizers

Free, interactive, no sign-up required. Each page animates the algorithm step by step
with synchronized pseudocode, a complexity table, and answers to common questions.

- [Sorting Visualizer](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/visualizer/sorting/) — Bubble, insertion, selection, merge, quick and heap sort animations with Big-O comparison
- [Binary Search Visualizer](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/visualizer/searching/) — Low/high/mid pointer convergence, O(log n) explained
- [Binary Tree Visualizer](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/visualizer/trees/) — BST insertion and deletion, in-order, pre-order, post-order and level-order traversal
- [Graph Visualizer](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/visualizer/graphs/) — BFS, DFS, Dijkstra shortest path, cycle detection
- [Dynamic Programming Visualizer](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/visualizer/dp/) — Memoization vs tabulation, knapsack, LCS, coin change tables
- [Recursion Visualizer](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/visualizer/recursion/) — Call stack frames building and unwinding
- [Backtracking Visualizer](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/visualizer/backtracking/) — Decision trees, pruning, N-Queens and permutations
- [Heap Visualizer](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/visualizer/heaps/) — Sift-up and sift-down in both tree and array views
- [Hash Table Visualizer](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/visualizer/hash-table/) — Hashing, collisions, separate chaining and linear probing
- [Linked List Visualizer](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/visualizer/linked-list/) — Insertion, deletion, reversal, cycle detection
- [Stack Visualizer](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/visualizer/stack/) — LIFO operations, balanced parentheses, monotonic stack
- [Queue Visualizer](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/visualizer/queue/) — FIFO operations, circular queue, deque
- [Array Visualizer](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/visualizer/arrays/) — Indexing, insertion, deletion and the cost of shifting
- [Two Pointers Visualizer](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/visualizer/two-pointers/) — Converging, fast/slow and same-direction pointer patterns
- [Sliding Window Visualizer](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/visualizer/sliding-window/) — Fixed and variable windows, incremental aggregates
- [Trie Visualizer](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/visualizer/trie/) — Character-by-character insertion, prefix search, and autocomplete
- [Dijkstra Visualizer](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/visualizer/dijkstra/) — Priority queue relaxation and shortest paths on weighted graphs
- [Bubble Sort Visualizer](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/visualizer/bubble-sort/) — Adjacent element comparisons and animated swapping
- [0/1 Knapsack Visualizer](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/visualizer/knapsack/) — Dynamic programming table filling and optimal traceback
- [Algorithm Comparison Visualizer](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/visualizer/compare/) — Side-by-side sorting algorithm race and Big-O benchmark

## Low-Level Design (LLD) Machine Coding Projects

Each project includes: class diagram, design patterns applied, SOLID principles, key entities, and complete implementation guide.

- [Design a Parking Lot System](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/lld/projects/design-parking-lot/) — Singleton, Factory, Strategy, Observer; multi-floor lot with automated billing
- [Design an In-Memory Cache (LRU/LFU)](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/lld/projects/design-cache-system/) — Strategy, Doubly LinkedList, HashMap, ReadWriteLock; configurable eviction
- [Design a Distributed Rate Limiter](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/lld/projects/design-rate-limiter/) — Token Bucket, Sliding Window Log, Decorator; API rate limiting
- [Design an Elevator Control System](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/lld/projects/design-elevator-system/) — State, Strategy, Dispatcher, Observer; LOOK/SCAN scheduling
- [Design Expense Sharing (Splitwise)](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/lld/projects/design-splitwise/) — Composite, Observer, Min-Cost Graph Flow; bill simplification
- [Design Movie Ticket Booking (BookMyShow)](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/lld/projects/design-bookmyshow/) — Command, Concurrency Locks, Factory, State; seat reservation
- [Design Snake and Ladder Game](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/lld/projects/design-snake-and-ladder/) — Command, Singleton, Strategy; multiplayer board game
- [Design Tic-Tac-Toe Game (N x N)](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/lld/projects/design-tic-tac-toe/) — Strategy, Observer, State; O(1) win evaluation
- [Design a Vending Machine](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/lld/projects/design-vending-machine/) — State Pattern, Chain of Responsibility, Inventory; state transitions
- [Design an ATM System](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/lld/projects/design-atm/) — State, Chain of Responsibility, Decorator; cash dispenser chain
- [Design a Chess Game](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/lld/projects/design-chess-game/) — Command, Factory, Strategy, Observer; move validation, checkmate
- [Design Hotel Room Management System](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/lld/projects/design-hotel-management/) — Factory, State, Strategy; room types, housekeeping, invoicing
- [Design Library Management System](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/lld/projects/design-library-management/) — Observer, Factory, Strategy; barcode scanning, fine calculation
- [Design a Custom Logging Framework](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/lld/projects/design-logging-framework/) — Chain of Responsibility, Singleton, Adapter; multi-handler logging
- [Design a Notification Library](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/lld/projects/design-notification-service/) — Observer, Factory, Strategy, Decorator; Push, SMS, Email delivery

Topic-wise multiple-choice practice with explanations.

- [DSA MCQ](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/mcq/quiz/dsa) — Data structures, algorithm complexity, sorting, searching

## Documentation Topics

- [JavaScript](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/javascript/) — Fundamentals, closures, async/await, ES6+, event loop
- [React](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/react/) — Hooks, state management, performance, component patterns
- [Angular](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/angular/) — Components, services, RxJS, dependency injection
- [Node.js](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/nodejs/) — Express, streams, event-driven architecture, REST APIs
- [Next.js](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/nextjs/) — SSR, SSG, App Router, API routes
- [TypeScript](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/typescript/) — Types, generics, decorators, utility types
- [DSA](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/data-structures/) — Arrays, trees, graphs, dynamic programming
- [System Design HLD](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/hld/) — Distributed systems, scalability, CAP theorem
- [LLD](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/lld/) — Object-oriented design, design patterns, SOLID
- [SQL / MySQL](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/sql/) — Joins, indexes, transactions, query optimization
- [MongoDB](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/mongodb/) — Documents, aggregation, indexing, schema design
- [Docker](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/docker/) — Containers, images, compose, networking
- [OOP](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/oops/) — Encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, abstraction
- [Behavioral](https://interviewpreprationbuddy.in/behavioral/) — STAR method, common HR questions
